visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: HashSet Instead of Nested Loops
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each element is compared with all the elements before it to find the first duplicate. Remember the seen values in a HashSet. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A set answers "have I seen this before?" in constant time, so one pass is enough. The nested loops compare every pair, which takes n squared steps.
